'''Stanley''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] clerk who worked in the repair [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] station [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He was happy working for [[Nirama]], although he would have not opposed to becoming a union. He mistakenly believed that [[The Cell]], a criminal faction wanting to oust Nirama, was some union in project.
